facts.claim: sales and use tax rate on adult-use cannabis
facts.source_name: Comptroller of Maryland, quarterly adult-use cannabis tax revenue reports
facts.verify: Rate rose from 9 to 12 percent on 2025-07-01 under the Budget Reconciliation and Financing Act of 2025. The Comptroller's quarterly releases describe Jul-Sep 2025 as the first full quarter at 12 percent.
facts.note: TRAP: the Comptroller's static page at marylandcomptroller.gov/cannabis.html still states 9 percent and is out of date. Cite the quarterly report, never that page. Re-verify before every Maryland publish, since a further increase to 15 percent was proposed for fiscal 2027 in the BRFA and may or may not have taken effect.

facts.claim: adult-use cannabis sales and use tax collected, January to March 2026
facts.verify: Headline figure 26.2 million for the January to March 2026 quarter

facts.claim: adult-use cannabis sales began in Maryland
facts.source_name: Comptroller of Maryland, adult-use cannabis tax page
facts.verify: Page states the cannabis sales and use tax took effect 2023-07-01, which is the start of legal adult-use sales
facts.note: Only the effective-date element of this page is used. Its 9 percent rate figure is stale, see md-sales-tax.

facts.label: Dispensary locations with a physical address
facts.source: Maryland Cannabis Administration, Dashboard Data Download JUN 2026, sheet 'Dispensaries Address Data' (119 rows) and sheet 'Dispensaries by County' (sums to 119)

facts.label: Dispensaries in Baltimore City
facts.source: MCA Dashboard Data Download JUN 2026, sheet 'Dispensaries by County', row 'Baltimore City'
facts.verify: Sheet 'Dispensaries by County', row 'Baltimore City' = 11. Confirm against 'Dispensaries Address Data' filtered to County = 'Baltimore City'.
facts.note: CRITICAL: Baltimore City is an independent city and belongs to no county. The separate row 'Baltimore' = 20 is Baltimore COUNTY. Never add them, and never report 20 as the city figure.

facts.label: Dispensaries in Baltimore County (separate jurisdiction)
facts.source: MCA Dashboard Data Download JUN 2026, sheet 'Dispensaries by County', row 'Baltimore'
facts.verify: Sheet 'Dispensaries by County', row 'Baltimore' = 20. Largest single jurisdiction in the state.
facts.note: Baltimore County is the state's largest dispensary jurisdiction, ahead of Montgomery County's 19. It surrounds but excludes Baltimore City.

facts.label: Baltimore County stores with a Baltimore mailing address and Baltimore in the trade name
facts.source: MCA Dashboard Data Download JUN 2026, sheet 'Dispensaries Address Data', rows where County = 'Baltimore' and the geocoding address city is 'Baltimore'
facts.verify: Health for Life Baltimore, 6807 Rolling Mill Rd, Baltimore MD 21224; Green Goods Baltimore, 717 North Point Blvd, Baltimore MD 21224. County field reads 'Baltimore' (the county), not 'Baltimore City'.
facts.note: ZIP 21224 straddles the line: Greenlabs at 1522 Eastern Ave is Baltimore City in the same ZIP. This is the boundary trap the page is built on.
